summary: Tested 4 bug fixes: Navigation sidebar background only on logo section, Logo controls (Fit/Transparent/BgColor), Color picker responsiveness on mobile, and SimpleCropTool touch event handlers. All fixes verified in code and via UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 UI fixes verified: 1) Nav background only on logo header (Navigation.js lines 322-339, height 200px section), 2) Logo controls visible in WebsiteDesignManager (Contain/Cover/Stretch buttons, Transparent BG toggle, Logo BG Color), 3) Color pickers use responsive width w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:w-80, 4) SimpleCropTool has touch handlers (onTouchStart/Move/End) and touch-none CSS class.

navigation_background_on_logo_only.details: Navigation.js lines 322-339: Background image/texture/color only applied to logo header section (200px height). Menu items area below has plain navBackgroundColor.

logo_fit_controls.details: WebsiteDesignManager shows Logo Fit buttons (Contain/Cover/Stretch) when logo is uploaded. data-testid='logo-fit-contain/cover/fill' found and clickable.

transparent_background_toggle.details: WebsiteDesignManager shows Transparent Background toggle (data-testid='logo-bg-transparent-toggle'). Clicking it toggles the state and shows/hides Logo Background Color picker.

logo_background_color.details: When Transparent Background is OFF, Logo Background Color input appears (data-testid='logo-bg-color-input') with hex color value and native color picker.

color_picker_responsive_mobile.details: EnhancedColorPicker.js line 187 and AdvancedColorPicker.js line 179: dropdown uses 'w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:w-80 max-w-80' for responsive width on mobile.

simple_crop_tool_touch_events.details: SimpleCropTool.js lines 148-162: getEventCoords() handles both mouse and touch events. Lines 363-366: canvas has onTouchStart/Move/End/Cancel handlers. Line 351: touch-none CSS class prevents scroll interference. Line 171: handleSize=20 for larger touch hit area.

simple_crop_tool_responsive_canvas.details: SimpleCropTool.js lines 352-354: canvas has width: '100%' and maxWidth for responsive sizing on mobile.
